sentences.text: I further submit that, through the intervention of impartial mediators the petitioners and I (the 2nd respondent) have compromised in the above said case.
I have no interest in pursuing the complaint any further.
I am filing this affidavit voluntarily and of my own free will, requesting this Hon'ble Court to permit the compounding of the offence and quash the proceedings against the petitioners.
